name: Trust creation and declaration
text: This Declaration of Trust, made on / Oo} 24) OO , 2000, by Wells Fargo Bank Minnesota, N.A. as Trustee, creates a Maryland business trust for the investment and reinvestment of money and property received by the Trust from time to time. The Trustee declares that all money and property received by the Trust shail be held and managed in trust pursuant to this Declaration of Trust. The name of the Trust created by this Declaration is the Wells Fargo Trust for Securities Lending (the “Trust”),

name: Recital (c) Tax and participation intentions
text: fc) The Trustee further intends that the Trust created hereby not be considered a “publicly traded partnership” for federal income tax purposes and to that end commits to limiting participation in the Trust to less than 100 Shareholders. The Trustees further intend that the Trust not be subject to taxation in the State of Maryland.

name: Section 2.1 Management of the Trust
text: Section 2.1 Management of the Trust. The business and affairs of the Trust shall be managed by or under the direction of the Trustee, and it shall have all powers necessary or desirable, convenient or incidental, to carry out that responsibility. The Trustee may execute all instruments and take all action it of 20 CONFIDENTIAL deems necessary, desirable, convenient or incidental, to promote the interests of the Trust. Any determination made by the Trustee in good faith as to what is in the interests of the Trust shall be conclusive.

name: Section 2.2(a) Number and qualification
text: Section 2.2 Number of Trustees; Term of Office. (a) There shall be one trustee, except as the Trustee may determine otherwise, Any trustee shall qualify in all respects as a trustee under the Maryland Act.

name: Section 2.2(b) Term, resignation, and removal
text: (b) The Trustee shall hold office for the duration of the Trust or until its successor is elected or the Trust terminates; except that (i) the Trustee may resign by delivering to the Shareholders a written resignation effective not less than thirty days subsequent to delivery or a later date specified therein; and (i) the Trustee and any successor Trustee may be removed by a vote of at least two-thirds of the Outstanding Shares at a meeting of the Shareholders called for such purpose,

name: Section 2.3 Vacancies; Appointment of Successor Trustees
text: Section 2.3 Vacancies; Appointment of Successor Trustees. Whenever a Trustee has resigned or been removed, and regardless of the reason for such vacancy, the remaining Trustee or Trustees may appoint any person as they determine in their sole discretion to fill that vacancy. Such appointment shall be made by a written Instrument signed by the remaining Trustee or, as the case may be, a majority of the Trustees, or by an appropriate resolution, duly adopted and recorded in the records of the Trust, specifying the effective date of the appointment. The Trustees may appoint a new Trustee as provided above in anticipation of a vacancy expected to occur because of the resignation or removal of a Trustee, or an increase in number of Trustees, provided that such appointment shall become effective only at or after the expected vacancy occurs. AS soon as any such Trustee has signed this Declaration or otherwise accepted his or her appointment in writing, the trust estate shall vest in the new Trustee, together with the continuing Trustees, without any further act or conveyance, and he or she shall be deemed a Trustee hereunder.

name: Section 2.4 Temporary Vacancies or Absence
text: Section 2.4 Temporary Vacancies or Absence. Whenever a Trustee vacancy exists and until such vacancy is filled, the remaining Trustees shal! have al! the powers hereunder and their certification as to such vacancy, absence, or incapacity or inability shall be conclusive. Any Trustee may, by power of attorney, delegate his or her powers as Trustee for a period not exceeding six (6) months at any one time to any other Trustee or Trustees.

name: Section 2.5 Ownership of Trust Property
text: Section 2.5 Ownership of Trust Property. The Trust Property of the Trust and of each Series shall be held separate and apart from any assets now or hereafter held in any capacity (other than as Trustee hereunder) by the Trustee or any successor Trustee. All of the Trust Property and legal title thereto shall at all times be considered as vested in the Trustee on behalf of the Trust, except that the Trustee may cause legal title to any Trust Property to be held by or in the name of the Trust, or in the name of any person as nominee. name: Section 2.6 Compensation of Trustee
text: Section 2.6 Compensation of Trustee. The Trustee may receive such compensation for its services and reimbursement for expenses as may be fixed from time to time by the Trustee and disclosed by written notice to the Shareholders.

name: Section 3.1 — Trustee’s Investment Power
text: applicable flaw, the Trustee shall not in any way be bound by current or future laws or customs applicable to trust investments, but shall have full power and authority to make any investments which it, in its sole discretion, deems proper to accomplish the purposes of the Trust, consistent with the investment objectives established by the Trustee for the Trust and/or the separate Series of the Trust.

name: Section 3.2 Certain Transactions
text: Section 3.2 Certain Transactions. Except as prohibited by applicable law, expressly including ERISA, the Trustee may, on behalf of the Trust, buy any securities from or sell any securities to, or lend any assets of the Trust to, any Trustee or officer of the Trust or any firm of which any such Trustee or officer is a member, acting as principal, or have any such dealings with any investment adviser, administrator, principal underwriter or transfer agent for the Trust. In addition, except as limited by ERISA, the Trust may employ any such person or entity in which such person is a broker, lega! counsel, registrar, investment adviser, administrator, distributor, transfer agent, dividend disbursing agent, custodian or in any other capacity upon customary terms.

name: Section 3.3 Standard of Care for ERISA Shareholders
text: Section 3.3 Standard of Care for ERISA Shareholders. -In the event that a Shareholder is a qualified employee benefit plan subject to the provisions of ERISA, the Trustee hereby acknowledges that it is a fiduciary of such plan to the extent of the Investment of assets of such plan in any Shares of the Trust. As such, the Trustee shall perform its duties herein with the care, skill, prudence, and diligence under the circumstances then prevailing that a prudent person acting in a like capacity and familiar with such matters would use in the conduct of an enterprise of a like character and with like aims.

text: Section 4.3. Eligibility for Participation. text: Section 4.5 Investment in the Trust. The Trust may accept investments in any Series from any persons and in any form, subject to such limitations or of 20 CONFIDENTIAL terms as the Trustee may from time to time impose. Unless the Trustee directs otherwise, such Investments may be in the form of cash or securities in which that Series is authorized to invest, valued as provided in Article Five, Section 5.3. name: Section 4.6(a) Assets belonging to a Series
text: Section 4.6 Assets and Liabilities of Series. (a) All consideration received by the Trust for the issue or sale of Shares of a particular Series, together with all assets in which such consideration is invested or reinvested, all income, earnings, profits, and proceeds thereof (including any proceeds derived from the sale, exchange or liquidation of such assets, and any funds or payments derived from any reinvestment of such proceeds in whatever form the same may be), shall be held and accounted for separately from the other assets of the Trust and every other Series and are referred to as “assets belonging to” that Series. The assets belonging to a Series shall belong only to that Series for all purposes, and to no other Series, and shall be subject only to the rights of creditors of that Series. Any assets, income, earnings, profits, and proceeds thereof, funds, or payments which are not readily identifiable as belonging to any particular Series shall be allocated by the Trustee between and among one or more Series as the Trustee deem fair and equitable. Each such allocation shall.be conclusive and binding upon the Shareholders of all Series for all purposes. name: Section 4.6(b) Series liability limitations
text: (b} Without limiting the foregoing, but subject to the right of the Trustee to allocate general liabilities, expenses, costs, charges or reserves as herein provided, the debts, liabilities, obligations and expenses incurred, contracted for or otherwise existing with respect to a particular Series shall be enforceable against the assets of such Series only, and not against the assets of the Trust generally or of any other Series and, unless otherwise provided in this Declaration, none of the debts, liabilities, obligations, expenses Incurred, contracted for or otherwise existing with respect to the Trust generally or any other Series shall be enforceable against the assets of such Series. Any person extending credit to, contracting with or having any claim against any Series may look only to the assets of that Series to satisfy or enforce any debt, with respect to that Series. Any person extending credit to, contracting with or having any claim against any Series may look only to the assets of that Series to satisfy or enforce any debt, with respect to that Series. No Shareholder or former Shareholder of any Series shall have a claim on any assets allocated or belonging to any other Series.

name: Section 4.7(a) Share register
text: Section 4.7 Ownership and Transfer of Shares. (a) The Trust shail maintain a register containing the names and addresses of the Shareholders of each Series, the number of Shares of each Series held by such Shareholders, and a record of all Share transfers. The register shall be conclusive as to the identity of Shareholders of record and the number of Shares held by them from time to time.

name: Section 4.7(b) Certificates, transfers, and addresses
text: (b) Shares shall be uncertificated unless expressly authorized by the Trustee. The Trustee may authorize the issuance of certificates representing Shares and adopt rules governing their use. The Trustee may make rules governing the transfer of Shares, whether or not represented by certificates. No Shareholder of record shall be entitled to payments of distributions, nor to any notice given, until it has given its address to such officer or agent as shall keep the register.

name: Section 4.8 No Voting Rights
text: Section 4.8 No Voting Rights. Shareholders shall have no right to amend or terminate this Declaration of Trust or to appoint, select, vote for or remove the Trustee or its agents or otherwise to participate in the business decisions of the Trust.

name: Section 4.9 Non-transferability of Shares
text: Section 4.9 Non-transferability of Shares. The beneficial interest in the Trust of a Shareholder shall not be transferable and any purported transfer shall be void and of no effect. Neither the Trustee nor any agent of the Trust shall be entitled or required to recognize any legal, equitable or other claim or interest in the Trust on the part of such purported transferee, whether or not any of them shall have express or other notice of such claim or interest. In addition, the Shares have not been, and are not expected to be, registered under federal or state securities laws.

name: Section 4.10 Status of Shares; Limitation of Shareholder Liability
text: Section 4.10 Status of Shares; Limitation of Shareholder Liability. Shares shall be deemed to be personal property giving Shareholders only the rights provided in this Declaration. Every Shareholder, by virtue of having acquired a Share, shall be held expressly to have agreed to be bound by the terms of this Declaration and to have become a party hereto. No Shareholder, as such, shail be personally liable for the debts, liabilities, obligations and expenses incurred by or 10 of 20 CONFIDENTIAL otherwise existing with respect to, the Trust or any Series. Shareholders, as such, shall have the same limitation of personal liability as is extended to Stockholders of a private corporation for profit organized under the General Corporation Law of the State of Maryland. Every written obligation of the Trust or any Series shail contain a statement to the effect that such obligation may only be enforced against the assets of the Trust or such Series; however, the omission of such statement shall not operate to bind or create personal liability for any Shareholder or Trustee or — any other Series.

name: Section 5.1 Distributions
text: Section 5.1 Distributions. The Trustee may declare and pay dividends and other distributions, including dividends on Shares of a -particular Series and other distributions from the assets belonging to that Series. The amount and payment of dividends or distributions and their form, whether they are in cash, Shares or other Trust Property, shall be determined by the Trustee in its discretion. All dividends and other distributions on Shares of a particular Series shall be distributed pro rata to the Shareholders of that Series in proportion to the number of Shares of that Series they held on the record date established for such payment. The Trustee may adopt and offer to Shareholders such dividend reinvestment plans, cash dividend payout plans or similar plans as the Trustee deems appropriate.

The Trustee may delegate the power and duty to determine Net Asset Value per Share to one or more or officers of the Trust or to a custodian, depository or other agent appointed for such purpose. text: Section 5.4 Suspension of Right of Redemption. name: Section 6.1 Management Agreements
text: Section 6.1 Management Agreements. The Trustee may enter into one or more investment advisory or management contracts on behalf of the Trust or any Series, providing for investment advisory services, statistical and research facilities and services, and other facilities and services to be furnished to the Trust or Series on terms and conditions acceptable to the Trustee. Any such contract may provide for the investment adviser to effect purchases, sales or exchanges of portfolio securities or other Trust Property on behalf of the Trustee or may authorize any officer or agent of the Trust to effect such purchases, sales or exchanges pursuant to recommendations of the investment adviser. The Trustee may authorize the investment adviser to employ one or more sub-advisers. No Such contract may provide, however, for the retention of the Trustee or any of its affiliates to provide additional services for additional compensation beyond that disclosed and agreed to in the various written agreements entered into between Shareholders and the Trustee governing the securities lending program administered by the Trustee or its affiliates.

name: Section 6.2 Transfer Agency, Accounting, and Other Services
text: Section 6.2 Transfer Agency, Accounting, and Other Services. The Trustee, on behalf of the Trust or any Series, may enter into one or more transfer agency, accounting, administration contracts and contracts for such other services deemed necessary .or appropriate by the Trustee to carry out the business and affairs of the Trust with any party or parties on terms and conditions acceptable to the Trustee.

name: Section 6.3 Custodian
text: Section 6.3 Custodian. The Trustee may employ from time to time one or more broker-dealers, brokers, banks or trust companies as custodian for the securities and similar investments of the Trust and of each Series to hold all or part of the Trust Property pursuant to a custodian agreement. The Trustee, on behalf of the Trust or any Serles, may enter into one or more such agreements with a custodian on terms and conditions acceptable to the Trustee, providing for the custodian, among other things, to (t) hold the securities owned by the Trust or any 12 of 20 So | CONFIDENTIAL Series and deliver the same upon written order or oral order confirmed in writing, (il) receive and receipt for any moneys due to the Trust or any Series and deposit ~ the same in its own banking department or elsewhere, (Ili) disburse such funds upon orders or vouchers, and (iv) employ one or more sub-custodians.

name: Section 6.4 Affiliated Parties
text: Section 6.4 Affiliated Parties. The Trustee may enter into any contract with any entity, even if affiliated with the Trustee and no such contract shall be invalidated or rendered void or voidable because of such relationship. No person having such a relationship shafl be disqualified from voting on or executing a contract in his or her capacity as Trustee and/or Shareholder, or be liable merely by reason of such relationship for any loss or expense to the Trust with respect to such a contract or accountable for any profit realized directly or indirectly therefrom; provided, that the contract was reasonable and fair and not inconsistent with this Declaration.

name: Article Seven Expenses of the Trust and Series
text: ARTICLE SEVEN EXPENSES OF THE TRUST AND SERIES Subject to Article Four, Section 4.4, the Trust or a particular Series shall pay, or shall reimburse the Trustee, from the Trust estate or the assets belonging to the particular Series, for its expenses and disbursements, including, but not limited to, Interest charges, taxes, brokerage fees and commissions; expenses of issue, repurchase and redemption of Shares; insurance premiums; applicable fees, interest charges and expenses of third parties, including the Trust’s investment advisers, managers, administrators, distributors, custodians, transfer agents and fund accountants; fees of pricing, interest, dividend, credit and other reporting services; costs of membership In trade associations; telecommunications expenses; funds transmission expenses; auditing, legal and compliance expenses; costs of preparing and printing the Shareholder reports and delivering them to Shareholders; expenses of meetings of Shareholders, if any ; costs of maintaining books and accounts; costs of reproduction, stationery and supplies: fees and expenses of the Trustee; and for such non-recurring items as may arise, including litigation to which the Trust or a Series (or a Trustee or officer of the Trust acting as such) is a party, and for all losses and liabilities incurred by it in administering the Trust. The Trustee shall have a lien on the assets belonging to the appropriate Trust or the Series, or in the case of an expense allocable to more than one Series, on the assets of each such Series, prior to any rights or interests of the Shareholders therete, for the reimbursement to it of such expenses or disbursements, or for any losses or liabilities to which it becomes subject in its capacity as Trustee.

name: Section 8.2(a) Mandatory Indemnification
text: Section 8.2 Mandatory Indemnification. (2) the Trust or the appropriate Series thereof shall indemnify each of its Covered Persons to the fullest extent permitted under the Maryland Act and other applicable laws, including: (i) against all tlabilities and expenses reasonably incurred or paid by him or her in connection with any claim, action, suit or proceeding in which he or she becomes involved as a party or otherwise by virtue of his or her being or having been a Covered Person and against amounts paid or incurred in the settlement thereof; and (il) apply to all claims, actions, suits or proceedings (civil, criminal or other, including appeals), actual or threatened, and the words “liability” and “expenses” shall include, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees, costs, judgments, amounts paid in settlement, fines, penalties and other liabilities.

name: Section 8.2(b) Indemnification rights and insurance
text: (bo) The rights of indemnification herein provided may be insured against by policies of insurance maintained by the Trust, shall be severable, shall not be exclusive of or affect any other rights to which any Covered Person may now or hereafter be entitled, and shall Inure to the benefit of the heirs, executors and administrators of a Covered Person.

name: Section 8.2(c) Advancement of defense expenses
text: (c) To the maximum extent permitted by the Maryland Act and other applicable laws, expenses in connection with the preparation and presentation of a defense to any claim, action, suit or proceeding of the character described in subsection (a) of this Section shall be paid by the Trust or applicable Series from time to time prior to final disposition thereof upon receipt of an undertaking by or on behalf of such Covered Person that such amount will be paid over by him or her to the Trust or applicable Series if it is ultimately determined that he or she is not entitled to indemnification under this Section; provided, however, that either (i) such Covered Person shall have provided appropriate security for such undertaking, (ii) the Trust is insured against losses arising out of any such advance payments or (iii) independent legal counsel in a written opinion, shall have determined, based upon a review of readily available facts (as opposed to a full trial-type inquiry) that there is reason to believe that such Covered Person will not be disqualified from indemnification under this Section; provided, however, that the Trust shall not be obligated to pay the expenses of any agent acting pursuant to a written contract with the Trust, except to the extent required by such contract;

name: Section 8.2(d) Prospective repeal or modification
text: (d) Any repeal or modification of this Article Seven shall be prospective ‘only, to the extent that such repeal or modification would, if applied retrospectively, affect any limitation on the {lability of any Covered Person in an a manner that would be adverse to such Covered Person or affect any indemnification available to any Covered Person in a manner that would be adverse to such Covered Person with respect to any act or omission which occurred prior to such repeal, modification or adoption.

name: Section 8.3 Indemnification of Shareholders
text: Section 8.3 Indemnification of Shareholders. If any Shareholder or former Shareholder of any Series shall be held personally liable solely by reason of his or her being or having been a Shareholder and not because of his or her acts or omissions or for some other reason, the Shareholder or former Shareholder (or his or her heirs, executors, administrators or other legal representatives or in the case cf any entity, its general successor) shall be entitled out of the assets belonging to the applicable Series to be held harmless from and indemnified against all loss and expense arising from such liability. The Trust, on behalf of the affected Series, shall, at its discretion, be entitled to assume the defense of any claim made against such Shareholder for any act or obligation of the Series and satisfy any judgment thereon from the assets of the Series.

name: Section 8.4 — Good-Faith Reliance
text: Section 8.4 Cantractual Modification of Duties. To the extent that, at law or equity, a Covered Person has duties (including fiduciary duties) and liabilities relating to the Trust or any Series thereof or to any Shareholder, any such Covered Person acting under this Declaration shall not be tlable to the Trust or any Series thereof or to any Shareholder for the Covered Person’s good faith reliance on the provisions of this Declaration.

name: Section 8.4 — Replacement of Other Duties
text: The provisions of this Declaration, to the extent that they restrict or limit the duties and liabilities of a Covered Person otherwise existing at law or In equity, are agreed by the parties hereto to replace such other duties and liabilities of such Covered Person.

name: Section §.5 Exception for ERISA Employee Benefit Plan Shareholders
text: Section §.5 Exception for ERISA Employee Benefit Plan Shareholders. The provisions of this Article Eight shalt not relieve a Trustee of any liability for any responsibility, obligation, or fiduciary duty imposed upon the Trustee by Part 4 of ERISA.

name: Section 9.1 Trust Not a Partnership
text: Section 9.1 Trust Not a Partnership. This Declaration creates a trust and not a partnership. No Trustee shall have any power to bind personally either the Jrust's officers or any Shareholder to any obligation to which such person has not consented.

name: Section 9.2 Trustee Action; Expert Advice; No Bond or Surety
text: Section 9.2 Trustee Action; Expert Advice; No Bond or Surety. The exercise by the Trustee of its powers and discretion in accordance with the terms of this Declaration in good faith under the circumstances then prevailing shall be binding upon everyone interested or affected thereby. Subject to the provisions of Article Eight, the Trustee shall not be Hable for errors of judgment or mistakes of 15 Case 1:09-cv-00041-WDM -BNB Document 294-1 Filed 08/12/10 USDC Colorado Page 17 — of 20 re CONFIDENTIAL fact or law. The Trustee may rely upon advice of counsel or other experts with respect to the meaning and operation of this Declaration, and subject to the provisions of Article Seven, shall not be liable for any act or omission in accordance with such advice or for failing to follow such advice. The Trustee shall not be required to give any bond as such, nor any surety if a bond is obtained.

name: Section 9.3(a) Dissolution or Termination
text: Section 9.3 Dissolution or Termination of a Series or of the Trust. (a) This Trust shall have perpetual existence. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Trustee may, without Shareholder approval (unless the Maryland Act or other applicable law expressly provides otherwise): (i) sell and convey all or substantially all of the assets of the Trust or any Series to another Series for adequate consideration, which may Include the assumption of all outstanding obligations, taxes and. other liabilities, accrued or contingent, of the Trust or any affected Series, and which may include Shares of or interests in such Series, entity, or series thereof; or (ii) at any time sell and convey, or convert into money, all or substantially all of the assets of the Trust or any affected Series; Upon payment or the making of reasonable provision for the payment of ail known liabilities of the Trust or any affected Series in either (i) or (ii), by assumption or otherwise, the Trustees may distribute the remaining proceeds or, assets (as the case may be) ratably among the Shareholders of the Trust or any affected Series; howéver, the payment to the Shareholders of any particular Series may be reduced by any fees, expenses or charges allocated to that Series; and may dissolve the Trust or any affected Series.

name: Section 9.3(b) Dissolution considerations
text: (b) In determining whether to dissolve the Trust or a Series, the Trustee may take into account whether continuation of the Trust or Series is in the best interests of the Trust or Series, or their respective Shareholders as a result of factors or events adversely affecting the ability of the Trust or such Series to conduct its business and operations in an economically viable manner. Such factors and events may include the inability of the Trust, or Series to maintain its assets at an appropriate size, changes in laws or regulations governing the Trust or Series or affecting assets of the type in which the Trust or Series invests, or economic developments or trends having a significant adverse impact on the business or operations of the Trust or Series. If the Trustee determines that the continuation of the Trust or Series is not in the best interests of the Trust, such Series or Shareholders, such determination is conclusive and binding upon the Trust, Series and their respective Shareholders.

name: Section 9.3(c) Trust termination and cancellation
text: (c) Upon completion of the winding up of the affairs of the Trust and the distribution of the remaining proceeds or assets pursuant to subsection (a), the Trust shall terminate and the Trustee and the Trust shall be discharged of any and all further Wabilities and duties hereunder with respect thereto and the right, title and interest of all parties therein shalt be canceled and discharged. Upon termination (as defined in the Maryland Act) of the Trust, following completion of winding up of its business, the Trustee shall cause a certificate of cancellation of the 16 Case 1:09-cv-00041-WDM -BNB Document 294-1 Filed 08/12/10 USDC Colorado Page 18 7 of 20 CONFIDENTIAL Trust’s Certificate of Trust, which may be signed by the Trustee, to be filed in accordance with the Maryland Act.

name: Section 9.3(d) Series termination
text: {d} The dissolution or termination of a Series shall not affect the existence of the Trust or any other Series. Upon completion of the winding up of the affairs of a terminated Series and the distribution of the assets pursuant to subparagraph (a}, the Trustee shall, by resolution or other written Instrument, record in the Trust’s books and records that the Series is terminated.

name: Section 9.4 Reorganization
text: Section 9.4 Reorganization. Unless Shareholder approval is expressly required under the Maryland Act, the Trustee may, without the need of any action or vote of the Shareholders or any other person or entity, (a) cause the Trust to merge or consolidate with or inte one or more business trust or other business entities (as defined under the Maryland Act), if the surviving or resulting entity is the Trust, or (b} cause the Trust to incorporate under the laws of Maryland. Pursuant to and in accordance with the provisions of Section 12-607 of the Maryland Act, an agreement of merger or consolidation approved by the Trustees in accordance with this Section 4 may effect any amendment te the Declaration or effect the adoption of a new governing Declaration of Trust if it is the surviving or resulting trust in the merger or consolidation.

name: Section 9.5 Declaration
text: Section 9.5 Declaration. The original or a copy of this Declaration and of each amendment hereto shall be kept at the office of the Trust, Anyone dealing with the Trust may-rely on a certificate by a Trustee as to the authenticity of the Declaration of Trust or any such amendments or supplements and as to any matters in connection with the Trust. This Declaration may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original.

name: Section 9.6 Applicable Law
text: Section 9.6 Applicable Law. This Declaration and the Trust created hereunder are governed by and construed and administered according to the Maryland Act and the applicabie laws of the State of Maryland except to the extent “F'iiray Otherwise be pre-empted by ERISA . The Trust shall be of the type commonly called a Maryland business trust, and, without limiting the provisions hereof, the Trust may exercise all powers which are ordinarily exercised by such a trust under Maryland law. The Trust specifically reserves the right to exercise any of the powers or privileges afforded to trusts or actions that may be engaged in by trusts under the Maryland Act, and the absence of a specific reference herein to any such power or privilege shall not imply that the Trust may not exercise such power or privilege or take such actions.

name: Section 9.7 Amendments
text: Section 9.7 Amendments. Because this Declaration does not confer any independent rights to Shareholders not expressly granted under Maryland law, this Declaration may be amended without Shareholder approval, and all Shareholders purchase Shares with notice that this Declaration may be so amended unless expressly required under the Maryland Act. The Trustee may, without any Shareholder vate, amend or otherwise supplement this Declaration by making an amendment, a trust Instrument supplemental hereto or an amended and restated 17 of 20 CONFIDENTIAL declaration of trust; provided, that Shareholders shall have the right to vote on any amendment submitted to them by the Trustee in its discretion.

name: Section 9.7 Fiscal Year
text: Section 9.7 Fiscal Year. The fiscal year of the Trust or specific Serles within the Trust shall end on a specific date as determined by the Trustee in this Declaration or by resolution or other written Instrument. The Trustee may change the fiscal year of the Trust, or any Series of the Trust without Shareholder approval.

name: Section 9.8 Severability
text: Section 9.8 Severability. The provisions of this Declaration are severable. If the Trustee determines, with the advice of counsel, that any provision hereof conflicts with the Maryland Act, the 1940 Act, or with other applicable laws and regulations, the conflicting provision shall be deemed never to have constituted a part of this Declaration; provided, however, that such determination shail not affect any of the remaining provisions of this Declaration or render invalid or improper any action taken or omitted prior to such determination. If any provision hereof shall be held invalid or unenforceable in any jurisdiction, such invalidity or unenforceability shall attach only to such provision only in such jurisdiction and shail not affect any other provision of this Declaration.

name: Section 9.9 Principal Office
text: Section 9.9 Principal Office. The principal office of the Trust shall be located at 11000 Broken Land Parkway, Columbia, Maryland 21044, or in such other location as the Trustee may from time to time determine.

name: Section 9.10 Inspection of the Books
text: Section 9.10 Inspection of the Books. Except as expressly required under the Maryland Act or conferred under other applicable law, Shareholders shall have no right to inspect the books of the Trust except as the Trustee may expressly authorize. The Trustee may authorize that the books of the Trust be apen to inspection by Shareholders under the conditions and regulations that it deems desirable.
